issues.problem: ContainerData carries progress, requiredProgress, a 64-bit CE value split into two 32-bit halves, and tier. Vanilla ClientboundContainerSetDataPacket sends each data slot as a short (16 bits), so the client receives truncated values. For example, 100,000 internal CE (1 CE) already exceeds 16 bits, so the GUI's CE readout and any progress above 32767 come out wrong.
issues.reason: The GUI has to show progress and CE accurately. Splitting a long into int halves does not survive the vanilla data-slot sync.
issues.fix: Split the CE value into 16-bit pieces (4 data slots for a long) and keep progress/required progress within 16 bits (or send them as a scaled ratio). Another option is to sync these values through a dedicated payload or the block-entity update tag. Then reassemble them in ClayMachineMenu.

If the stored recipe no longer resolves, press() returns the reserved stack to the input and clears the active recipe.
Not touched by the diff; still resolved.

issues.problem: press() checks level == null, level.isClientSide and the 1..6 range again, although its only caller (clickMenuButton on the server) already checks the range and always has a server level.
issues.reason: The style rule says to validate only states the game can produce and to keep one direct path.
issues.fix: Keep the range check in one place (clickMenuButton) and drop the redundant level/client checks in press().

history.note: fixed: 操作番号の検証をメニュー側に集約した。
The redundant level and range checks were dropped from press().
Not touched by the diff; still resolved.

issues.problem: Tool wear is done by hand with setDamageValue, and a broken tool is swapped for clay balls. This skips ItemStack.hurtAndBreak, so Unbreaking/enchantment handling, the break event and the break sound are all lost.
issues.reason: Use the vanilla durability mechanism before custom code.
issues.fix: Use tool.hurtAndBreak(1, (ServerLevel) level, null, item -> {}) and only keep extra break behavior if the original requires it.

history.note: fixed: 工具の耐久消費を ItemStack.hurtAndBreak に変更した。
Tool wear uses ItemStack.hurtAndBreak.
Not touched by the diff; still resolved.

issues.problem: The six actions are vanilla Buttons labeled "1"…"6", placed outside the 176px panel. Progress is drawn as a flat green fill() rectangle. The original clayworktable.png already contains the button icon sprites (normal/hover/disabled rows at u=176+) and the progress overlay, and none of them are used.
issues.reason: AC-F008-002 requires the GUI to match the 1.7.10 image. The original texture's button and progress graphics should be used instead of new widgets and colors.
issues.fix: Render the action buttons as image buttons (WidgetSprites or a custom blit) using the sprite regions of clayworktable.png. Place them inside the panel as the original did and keep imageWidth = 176. Blit the progress arrow overlay from the texture instead of fill().

history.note: fixed: 操作ボタンと進捗を原作 GUI PNG のスプライトで画面内に描画する。
Buttons and the progress overlay blit from clayworktable.png. The sprite coordinates match the texture, and the panel width is 176.
Not touched by the diff; still resolved.

issues.problem: The crafting board's 4px-tall element sets cullface(UP) on its top face at y=4, which is not on the block boundary. Its side faces also use the default full-height UV, so the 16px side texture is squashed into 4px.
issues.reason: When a block sits above the board, the top face is culled and you can see through it. The squashed sides do not match the original look.
issues.fix: Remove cullface from the UP face. Give the side faces uv(0, 12, 16, 16) and the bottom face a matching UV.

history.note: fixed: 作業板上面の cullface を除き、薄い側面に合う UV を指定した。
The up face no longer has a cullface. The side faces' default UV already covers the 4px height, and the generated JSON matches.
Not touched by the diff; still resolved.

issues.problem: cube() gets the model name by cutting "block.clayium." off getDescriptionId().
issues.reason: This depends on the translation-key format instead of the registry name.
issues.fix: Use BuiltInRegistries.BLOCK.getKey(block).getPath() (or pass the DeferredBlock and use getId().getPath()).

history.note: fixed: モデル名をブロックのレジストリ ID から取得する。
The model name comes from the BuiltInRegistries block key.
Not touched by the diff; still resolved.

issues.problem: WorkbenchToolItem is identical to the existing FoundationItem (super.appendHoverText plus FoundationTooltip.add). FoundationTooltip was made public only to support this copy.
issues.reason: This is duplicate implementation of the same responsibility.
issues.fix: Register the tools with FoundationItem, delete WorkbenchToolItem, and set FoundationTooltip back to package-private.

history.note: fixed: 工具を FoundationItem で登録し、重複クラスを削除した。
Tools are registered as FoundationItem, WorkbenchToolItem is deleted, and FoundationTooltip is package-private again.
Not touched by the diff; still resolved.

issues.problem: Both interfaces have no implementers and no callers. The wrench and configurator items never use them.
issues.reason: The style rule says to add an abstraction only when two call sites use it now. The wrench rotation and settings copy behavior belong to later milestones.
issues.fix: Delete both interfaces. Add them in the milestone that implements wrench rotation and settings copy.

history.note: fixed: 未使用の工具連携インターフェースを削除した。
Both unused interfaces are deleted.
Not touched by the diff; still resolved.

issues.problem: The two shapedTool overloads are each called once. The structurally identical raw_clay_spatula recipe right next to them is written inline.
issues.reason: The style rule says to introduce helpers only with two call sites and to keep one direct path.
issues.fix: Inline both shapedTool calls as ShapedRecipeBuilder chains, like the spatula, and delete the overloads.

history.note: fixed: 一度しか使わない shapedTool の両オーバーロードをインライン化した。
The shapedTool overloads are inlined and removed.
Not touched by the diff; still resolved.

issues.problem: The reachability closure accepts every loaded recipe of every type, including Clayium machine recipes that need powered machines and CE. It ignores the work-table tool needed for each action, so a part counts as reachable through a recipe no Tier 0 player can run. It never places a table or board and never crafts anything.
issues.reason: The test must prepare the precondition (vanilla resources only), perform the action (build the table/board, make tools and Tier 1 parts) and assert the result. Right now it can pass even if the Tier 0 path is broken.
issues.fix: Limit the closure to minecraft:crafting, minecraft:smelting and clayium:clay_work_table recipes. Only add a work-table output once the tool for its action (required_tier) is reachable. Alternatively, drive the real path: place the table, press with the crafted tools, and craft on the board.

history.note: fixed: 到達性検査をクラフト、製錬、作業台レシピに限定し、操作に必要な工具の到達性も確認する。
The closure is limited to crafting, smelting and work-table recipes, with tool reachability checked per action.
Not touched by the diff; still resolved.

issues.problem: The test calls extractItem/insertItem on the chest handler itself. It never crafts through the board menu, so it never checks that crafting draws materials from the chest.
issues.reason: The expected result, the board using adjacent chest stock as material, is not tested.
issues.fix: Open ClayCraftingBoardMenu with a mock player, set a recipe pattern in the grid, take the result, and assert that the chest counts drop by exactly the recipe's consumption while the output is received.

history.note: fixed: GameTest で作業板メニューから製作し、出力とチェストの消費数を検証する。
The test now crafts through the board menu and asserts the chest consumption and the output.
Not touched by the diff; still resolved.

issues.problem: Only the slot counts are checked. Nothing tests that the slots can be operated (placing into input/tool, rejecting output placement, shift-click, chest slot moves).
issues.reason: AC-F008-002 expects the GUI slots to be operable, and a count does not show that.
issues.fix: Use menu.clicked/quickMoveStack with the mock player to move items into the input and tool slots, from the output slots, and to and from the chest slots. Assert the resulting stacks.

history.note: fixed: GameTest で入力・工具・出力・チェストのスロット操作とシフトクリックを検証する。
The test now exercises menu clicks and quickMoveStack on the input, tool, output and chest slots.
Not touched by the diff; still resolved.

issues.problem: The workbench IDs are added to the expected set straight from WorkbenchRegistration, so the 'registry equals original ledger' check passes by definition for these entries.
issues.reason: AGENTS.md says the GameTest compares the registered IDs against original_varieties.tsv. The workbench IDs (clay_work_table, clay_crafting_board, raw_clay_machine_hull, clay_machine_hull, tool IDs) are in the ledger and should be checked from it.
issues.fix: Build the workbench part of the expected set from the ledger rows for the original keys (tile.blockClayWorkTable, tile.blockClayCraftingTable, tile.blockRawClayMachineHull.0, tile.blockMachineHull.0 and the item rows 428-438), not from the registration class.

history.note: fixed: 作業台と工具の期待 ID を原作台帳のキーから構築する。
The expected IDs are built from original_varieties.tsv rows by legacy key, and those keys exist in the TSV.
Not touched by the diff; still resolved.

issues.problem: One diagonal camera shot is used as both the front and the side view of both blocks.
issues.reason: AC-F008-002 asks for front and side captures.
issues.fix: Take separate front and side screenshots (e.g. yaw 0 and yaw 90 facing the blocks).

history.note: fixed: E2E に正面と側面の別々の撮影を追加した。
The E2E scenario now takes separate front and side screenshots.
The script still takes separate front (yaw 0) and side (yaw 90) screenshots. The diff only adds menu key presses at the start and doesn't change that.

issues.problem: M07 is not documented. Missing: the clay_work_table recipe method (also absent from the M03 RecipeType list), the meaning of required_tier as the action number 1-6 for this method and the tool required per action, the block/item/BlockEntity/menu IDs, tool tiers and durabilities, the crafting board's adjacent-inventory rule (directions, 27-slot cap), and the GameTest names.
issues.reason: The common rules require AGENTS.md to be updated with any change to user-visible behavior, IDs, registrations or verification steps.
issues.fix: Add an M07 section that records these values and rules. Add clay_work_table to the RecipeType list.

history.note: fixed: AGENTS.md に M07 の ID、工具、作業板の在庫規則、GameTest を記載し、RecipeType 一覧を更新した。
AGENTS.md now has the M07 section and clay_work_table in the RecipeType list.
Not touched by the diff; AGENTS.md still has the M07 section.

issues.problem: The Clay Work Table GUI mixes two languages. The mod title reads "Clay Work Table" in English, but the player inventory label right below it, drawn by the same screen, reads "物品栏" (Simplified Chinese). The rest of the GUI (background, the 6 operation buttons, the slots and the arrow) matches the original clayworktable.png layout and has no missing textures.
issues.reason: The E2E client runs in zh_cn. The mod only ships en_us and ja_jp lang files, so the mod's own labels fall back to English while the vanilla playerInventoryTitle is translated. This makes the GUI text inconsistent and different from the 1.7.10 reference in either supported language.
issues.fix: Set the harness client's language (options.txt `lang:`) to en_us or ja_jp, both of which the mod supports, and take the screenshot again. Do not add zh_cn translations unless they are required.

history.note: fixed: 作業台 GUI の撮影前に en_us を選択するようシナリオを変更しました。

In the new clay-work-table-gui screenshot, the title reads "Clay Work Table" and the player inventory label reads "Inventory". Both are in English, so the mixed zh_cn text is gone. The layout, the 6 operation buttons and the slots look intact.

issues.problem: The Clay Crafting Board GUI shows the English mod labels "Clay Crafting Board" and "Adjacent inventory", but the player inventory label reads "物品栏" (Simplified Chinese). The 3×3 grid, the arrow and output slot (which match claycraftingtable.png), the 27 adjacent-chest slots (showing the chest's 32 clay balls and 16 planks) and the player inventory are otherwise laid out without overlaps or missing textures.
issues.reason: This has the same cause as the work table GUI. The client locale is zh_cn, which the mod has no lang file for, so mod labels fall back to en_us while vanilla text is translated. The result is an inconsistent mixed-language GUI.
issues.fix: Run the E2E client with `lang:en_us` (or ja_jp) in options.txt so mod and vanilla labels use the same supported language, then take this screenshot again.

history.note: fixed: 同じ言語設定を作業板 GUI の撮影にも適用しました。

In the new crafting-board-adjacent-chest-gui screenshot, "Clay Crafting Board", "Adjacent inventory" and "Inventory" are all English. The "物品栏" label is gone. The 3×3 grid, the output slot and the adjacent chest slots (32 clay balls, 16 planks) have no overlaps or missing textures.
